bounded_reading: General protocol: capacity checks of three 0.5C full-SOC charge/discharge cycles; no exact row-specific counter/reset or interval-boundary definition.

Public helper uses a heuristic around empty cycles and a Cycle_Index-based EFC helper; neither supplies validated interval/counter semantics. It was read, not executed. Its value-based heuristic is not adopted for sample selection or role/representation classification.
Metadata supplies identity and nominal protocol labels, not per-row scientific roles or measured capacities.
